stem.text: Skeletal formulae of four organic compounds are shown.

stem.alt: Skeletal formula of compound 1: a short zig-zag chain ending in a C=O group.
Skeletal formula of compound 2: an ester with a C=O group and an O atom between two carbon chains.
Skeletal formula of compound 3: a short zig-zag chain ending in a C≡N group.
Skeletal formula of compound 4: an ester with a C=O group and an O atom between a propyl chain and a methyl group.

stem.text: Which two compounds when separately heated with dilute sulfuric acid produce propanoic acid as one of the products?
